batch_patterns.evidence: Every main-idea item carries one over-broad generic distractor (e.g. "Good roads have played an important part...", "New technology has made many everyday objects...", "how many different kinds of fish catch insects", "places where families can spend a summer weekend") and one single-detail distractor; the generic option is never the key (0 of 8), and in 5 of 8 (1,5,16,23,29) the key is a two-part summary. Weak tell: eliminates one option, does not decide the item.
